test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the same sequence in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

A_DF_AC_FB_CDF_ACD_D
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75a608befa20e0b1e3fe7b6ab428dc5556d0338ee67ae51b4d035e3142762bc0.png] 

**After filling the blanks with by given option :**

**1. **CDFCCA: Doesn't follow any pattern.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/500ccb886ea06a28c874f21430b75215a560e59c225975c299842beb3d5caa39.png] 

2. CDADFA: Doesn't follow any pattern .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7aa3747354a2b7216c4b2b78003969899813b1669fa57f7e457926db556de95a.png] 

3. CADACF : It follows a certain Pattern, **Here last letter of word is increasing by +1.**

**A+ 1 = B, B + 1 = C, C + 1 = D**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f47df332e44c3cb9935fa2ac06d24d704ad13f536865cd275ae16b408f30512b.png] 

4 CADFCC : Doesn't follow any pattern.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18fcec2699ab7081dbf89610dbe7f97da5b4579398f3235de13838dc423517bc.png] 

Hence correct answer is **'CADACF'.**
